name: Frostbound
author: The Lantern example
description: One of everything a pack can hold: a class, an ancestry, spells, items, a table, an extension and an override. Homebrew, invented for this file.

classes.name: Rimewalker
classes.text: Walks the ice roads and comes back. Casts on wisdom, and carries little.

ancestries.name: Frostborn
ancestries.talent: Born in the long winter. Cold weather never counts as harsh going for you.

spells.name: Hoarfrost
spells.text: Frost creeps over every surface you can see. Footing there is treacherous while you hold it.

spells.name: Glacial step
spells.text: You cross ice, snow and still water as though it were dry road.

items.name: Rimeblade
items.text: A blade of clouded ice that does not melt. It is cold to hold and colder to be hit by.

items.name: Storm torch
items.text: A pitch-soaked torch wound in oiled cloth, made for weather that puts an ordinary one out. Overrides the core torch, so a sheet already holding a torch shows this one.

rows.text: Choose any result on this table
Your light sources burn a quarter longer than anyone else's
+1 to spellcasting checks made in open winter weather
